outcome: operative delivery for intrapartum fetal compromise (IFC)
prognostic performance of CPR to predict operative delivery for IFC
cohort: 2,052 singleton pregnancies delivered between 37+0 and 41+6 weeks of gestation at a single tertiary referral center over an 8-year period
finding: Both SGA and AGA fetuses with low CPR had higher rates of operative delivery for IFC at term with advancing gestational age.
birth_weight: Small for gestational age (SGA, birthweight <10th centile) and appropriate for gestational age (AGA, birthweight 10th-90th centile)
